IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
wavy blonde hair walks a pale blue
runway in a long navy wool coat with
notched lapels, burgundy patent leather
cuffs, and burgundy piping. Navy
wide-leg trousers, a high navy velvet
collar, and navy gloves complete the
look. She carries a burgundy quilted
shoulder bag with silver chain. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, even
runway light. Palette of navy, burgundy,
and pale blue. Tailored and elegant, in
the style of a fall runway show.
